parsed.rationale: All four members are exact duplicates of the `data` method, each nested inside a per-test-class `SequentialMockSession` inner type (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` × 2) within the same file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` in the `Artwork` package. The duplication arises because each test class re-declares an identical mock helper rather than sharing a single top-level `SequentialMockSession` type. Extracting `SequentialMockSession` as a single file-scope (or test-support-module-scope) type within the `Artwork` test target would eliminate all four redundant declarations and make the mock reusable across all service test classes. Note: although the file path contains `Tests/`, the `is_test` context flag is recorded as `false` on all members, so the test-fixture no-action rule does not strictly apply; the duplication is nonetheless test-infrastructure code and the refactor is low-risk.
